transport.route: Playwright request interception delivered the browser HTTPS-origin requests through a local relay; the relay made each HTTPS request through a temporary SSH forward to Caddy loopback.
transport.tls_verification: Node TLS rejectUnauthorized=true and tls.checkServerIdentity(expected qa2.staging.test) with the public Caddy internal root CA; exact SNI qa2.staging.test; no insecure TLS option.

code_and_standards_review.review: Reviewed MarketingToursPage and host-derived B bootstrap, catalog fetch tenant forwarding/cache policy, and guest bootstrap exact host binding; runtime source hashes match the release commit. WRS-001 applies.

side_effects: Read-only catalog navigation. No business/config/identity records changed; no outbound messages. Temporary tunnel, certificate copy, and browser resources were cleaned after the probe.
limitations: The browser page did not negotiate TLS directly; the Playwright relay performed and verified TLS to staging before fulfilling each response to the HTTPS browser origin.
No wizard create/edit/publish, refresh persistence, or published-tour catalog match was exercised.
